Once her documents arrive, the next step is to run the ID check again and, if it passes, open the Premier Savings Account and book her M$7,900.

I updated Jeanne on both leads, including that we'll likely finish one account short. She replied "keep working your other leads," but there were only these two today. I've ended the shift and saved a handover note covering the above.
